item.title: RMCP: Unauthenticated permanent session-table leak in rmcp Streamable HTTP server transport leads to remote denial-of-service
item.description: Score 61/100 MEDIUM — CVSS 7.5 — ### Summary An unauthenticated remote attacker can leak one entry per HTTP request out of the in-memory session table of `LocalSessionManager` by sending a well-formed JSON-RPC `POST` that is *not* an `InitializeRequest`.
